package task

import (
	"context"
	"sort"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
)

// TaskProgress aggregates student progress for one task.
type TaskProgress struct {
	TaskID         string
	HasPassed      bool
	HasUnderReview bool
	LatestStatus   int
	LatestAnswerID string
}

// TaskProgressProvider fetches aggregated progress for tasks from external services.
type TaskProgressProvider interface {
	GetProgressByTaskIDs(ctx context.Context, userID string, taskIDs []string) (map[string]TaskProgress, error)
}

type lessonGetter interface {
	Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.Lesson, error)
}

type lessonTaskLister interface {
	ListByLesson(ctx context.Context, lessonID string) ([]domain.Task, error)
}

// InternalCompletedLessonsResponse contains completed lesson ids for one student.
type InternalCompletedLessonsResponse struct {
	UserID             string   `json:"user_id"`
	CompletedLessonIDs []string `json:"completed_lesson_ids"`
}

// GetInternalCompletedLessons resolves lesson completion using active lesson/task metadata and task-answer progress.
type GetInternalCompletedLessons struct {
	Lessons  lessonGetter
	Tasks    lessonTaskLister
	Progress TaskProgressProvider
}

// Handle returns completed lesson ids for the given user and lessons.
func (uc GetInternalCompletedLessons) Handle(ctx context.Context, userID string, lessonIDs []string) (*InternalCompletedLessonsResponse, error) {
	if userID == "" || uc.Lessons == nil || uc.Tasks == nil || uc.Progress == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	uniqueLessonIDs := uniqueStrings(lessonIDs)
	response := &InternalCompletedLessonsResponse{
		UserID:             userID,
		CompletedLessonIDs: make([]string, 0, len(uniqueLessonIDs)),
	}
	if len(uniqueLessonIDs) == 0 {
		return response, nil
	}

	type lessonState struct {
		activeTasks []domain.Task
		canComplete bool
	}

	states := make(map[string]lessonState, len(uniqueLessonIDs))
	taskIDs := make([]string, 0)

	for _, lessonID := range uniqueLessonIDs {
		lessonItem, err := uc.Lessons.Get(ctx, lessonID)
		if err != nil {
			if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
				continue
			}
			return nil, err
		}

		if lessonItem.Status != domain.LessonStatusActive {
			states[lessonID] = lessonState{canComplete: false}
			continue
		}

		tasks, err := uc.Tasks.ListByLesson(ctx, lessonID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}

		activeTasks := make([]domain.Task, 0, len(tasks))
		for _, taskItem := range tasks {
			if taskItem.Status != domain.TaskStatusActive {
				continue
			}
			activeTasks = append(activeTasks, taskItem)
			taskIDs = append(taskIDs, taskItem.ID)
		}

		states[lessonID] = lessonState{
			activeTasks: activeTasks,
			canComplete: true,
		}
	}

	progressMap, err := uc.Progress.GetProgressByTaskIDs(ctx, userID, uniqueStrings(taskIDs))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	for _, lessonID := range uniqueLessonIDs {
		state, ok := states[lessonID]
		if !ok || !state.canComplete {
			continue
		}
		if len(state.activeTasks) == 0 {
			response.CompletedLessonIDs = append(response.CompletedLessonIDs, lessonID)
			continue
		}

		completed := true
		for _, taskItem := range state.activeTasks {
			if !isCompletedLessonTask(taskItem, progressMap[taskItem.ID]) {
				completed = false
				break
			}
		}
		if completed {
			response.CompletedLessonIDs = append(response.CompletedLessonIDs, lessonID)
		}
	}

	sort.Strings(response.CompletedLessonIDs)
	return response, nil
}

func isCompletedLessonTask(taskItem domain.Task, progress TaskProgress) bool {
	if progress.HasPassed {
		return true
	}
	switch taskItem.EvaluationMode {
	case domain.TaskEvaluationModeManual, domain.TaskEvaluationModeHybrid:
		return progress.HasUnderReview
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func uniqueStrings(items []string) []string {
	if len(items) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(items))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		if item == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := seen[item]; ok {
			continue
		}
		seen[item] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, item)
	}
	return result
}
